name: spinal_fusion_neuropathy_review_schema_v1
description: Research-grade evidence review schema for spinal fusion surgery and associated neuropathy. This schema supports literature triage, extraction, and graph review only.
excluded_uses: causation determination for an individual case
review_questions: What neuropathic symptoms or neurologic complications are reported after spinal fusion?
Which fusion approaches, spinal levels, or perioperative factors are associated with neuropathy or radiculopathy in the literature?
What mechanisms are proposed, such as nerve root compression, traction, inflammation, scar tissue, hardware-related irritation, or adjacent segment disease?
What time course and outcomes are reported for postoperative neuropathic symptoms?
What treatments or follow-up interventions are reported, and what level of evidence supports them?
